text_block_list.text:
Today is finally Air Groove's
debut race...!

As I try to leave the inn early
to head to Sapporo Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, but go on ahead without me.
Something came up.

With those parting words,
Air Groove walked away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I came to cheer for you.
I really wanted to see your debut race, Senpai—
—Mejiro Dober. An Umamusume of the prestigious "Mejiro family."
The Mejiro family has Mejiro McQueen, an Umamusume renowned as a stayer.

There are many promising Umamusume,
such as Mejiro Ryan with her powerful running style.

And Mejiro Dober, just like them,
was one of those carrying the heavy weight
of everyone's high expectations on her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Not just me, but everyone who owes
you a debt of gratitude
is cheering you on... Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So today...
p-please do your best!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
I swear I will live up to those expectations.

I had been watching Air Groove from a distance,
and it seemed she noticed her junior, Mejiro Dober, and went over to talk to her.

After talking with Mejiro Dober,
the formidable aura around Air Groove
seemed to grow even more intense...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. However, this stems from—
my responsibility as the "Empress."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For those who believe in me...
I will embrace the weight of their support and deliver results.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you too must cast aside pointless worries and watch closely.
Watch the dawn of my reign—as the Empress.
